decisions.reason: As a strategic flagship linked to the firm's R&D base, its continued presence suggests results are at least near aspiration levels, and the firm's growth provides enough slack to keep learning despite some market uncertainty.

This decontamination plant is very close to the firm's core machinery offer and, after surviving the initial launch period as a flagship product, is likely performing well enough relative to aspirations to remain on the market.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits existing capabilities, customers, and commercialization channels closely, so management is more likely to continue refinement than to reallocate its resources elsewhere.
